status: frozen final author product, actual bilingual word-calibrated; root verification/static acceptance pending

cues.title: 用共振放大微弱响应
cues.titleEn: Amplify a weak response with resonance
cues.caption: 驱动频率接近共振频率时，金属棒的机械响应增强。
cues.zh: 韦伯尝试用大型金属棒响应引力波引起的微小形变，再用传感器转成电信号。驱动频率接近棒的共振频率，响应会增强。形变在画面里极度放大，数值仍按小应变模型计算。这里是装置原理示意，并不表示这根棒实际收到了引力波。
cues.en: Weber used large metal bars to seek tiny deformations from gravitational waves, converting motion into an electrical signal. Response increases near mechanical resonance. The drawing greatly magnifies deformation while the readout uses a small-strain model. It illustrates the proposed detector principle, not an actual detection.

cues.title: 共同出现，还要独立复核
cues.caption: 早期韦伯棒的探测宣称，没有获得独立实验确认。
cues.captionEn: Weber’s claim was not independently confirmed.
cues.zh: 把远处两个探测器的信号放到一起，是排查局部干扰的方法之一，但相似波形本身还不够。下方两条曲线人为加入共同的阻尼振动和不同背景，用来说明比较方法。韦伯早年的引力波探测宣称没有被独立证实，不能把这段科学史讲成引力波已经被发现。
cues.en: Comparing separated detectors can help reject local disturbances, but similar traces are not enough. These curves deliberately combine a common damped oscillation with different backgrounds to explain the method. Independent experiments failed to confirm Weber’s early claims. This history must not be presented as an established gravitational-wave discovery.

cues.title: 把脉冲星当作计时信号
cues.titleEn: Use a pulsar as a timing signal
cues.caption: 轨道运动改变脉冲到达间隔，连续计时约束双星轨道。
cues.zh: 双星中的脉冲星提供反复到达的射电信号。它沿视线靠近和远离时，脉冲到达间隔发生周期变化。图中两星按偏心轨道绕质心运动，底部周期来自视线速度的低速多普勒近似。它只说明计时原理，真实脉冲星分析还包含传播、引力和参考系校正。
cues.en: A pulsar supplies repeated radio pulses. As it approaches and recedes along the line of sight, arrival intervals change periodically. The stars follow eccentric barycentric orbits and the plotted period uses a low-speed Doppler approximation. Real timing also corrects propagation, gravity and reference-frame effects.

cues.title: 每一圈略早，几十年会怎样？
cues.titleEn: A little earlier each orbit: what accumulates?
cues.caption: 周期略短，近星点更早到达。
cues.captionEn: Shorter periods make periastron arrive earlier.
cues.zh: 这些点来自已发表的脉冲星计时记录。横线表示轨道周期不变的参考。为什么测得的到达时刻越来越早？引力辐射带走能量，轨道结合得更紧，间距减小，每圈时间就更短。金色曲线是论文另外给出的广义相对论预测。先想一想，后来的记录应该靠近哪条线？现在揭开原有的后段观测点。这里累计提前约一分钟，并不是每圈的周期缩短了一分钟。它来自许多次很小的提前，是射电计时提供的间接证据。
cues.en: These are published pulsar timing records. The horizontal reference assumes an unchanged orbital period. Why do arrivals become earlier? Radiation carries away energy, leaving a more tightly bound, smaller orbit with a shorter period. The gold line is the paper’s separately published general-relativity prediction. Which line should the later records approach? Now reveal those original observations. About a minute of accumulated early arrival does not mean that each orbit became a minute shorter. Many tiny advances add up. Radio timing supplies indirect evidence.

cues.title: 跟光走一趟，再看合成
cues.titleEn: Follow the round trip, then combine the fields
cues.caption: 光程差改变回程相位，合成光场决定读出。
cues.zh: 先跟着同一束光：分成两路，遇到端镜返回，再汇合到探测器。这里用较大的教学位移和明确的偏置工作点，把原理看清。一臂伸长，另一臂缩短，往返光程不同，两路返回光的相位就错开。合成的波改变，探测器的光强也改变。先预测：如果两臂一起等量伸长呢？相位一起变，相对差不变，差分信号为零。反转差分位移，偏置读出的变化也反向。回到真实量级，四千米光臂的差分只有四阿米，相位变化约四点七二乘十的负十一次方弧度。真实LIGO还需要光学腔、反馈和校准。
cues.en: Follow one beam: split it, reflect both parts from the end mirrors, then recombine them at the detector. Larger teaching displacements and an explicit biased operating point make the mechanism visible. Opposite arm changes alter round-trip path difference, shifting the returning phases. Their summed field changes the detected power. Predict what happens if both arms lengthen equally. Both phases change together: their difference, and the differential signal, stay unchanged. Reverse the differential motion and the biased signal reverses. At the physical scale, four-kilometre arms differ by just four attometres, a phase change of roughly four-point-seven-two times ten to the minus eleven radians. Real LIGO adds optical cavities, feedback and calibration.

cues.title: 两站真实记录，保留各自的噪声
cues.titleEn: Two real records, with their independent noise
cues.caption: 两站记录可比较，但不是同一条理论曲线的复制。
cues.captionEn: Two real signals retain different noise.
cues.zh: 现在看二零一五年九月十四日的真实记录，已按论文的方法滤波。两站的波形相近，细小噪声却各不相同。为了叠放比较，官方图把汉福德记录前移七毫秒，并按两站的相对朝向反号。观察前后几个周期：后面的间隔更短。致密双星失去轨道能量，间距减小、绕转加快，旋近的引力波频率随之上升。这里的轨道模型用于解释，不是重新拟合事件。回到记录，利文斯顿先收到信号；论文测得的时差约六点九毫秒。两站一致性还要结合仪器检查和噪声统计，不能只凭一段相似波形宣布发现。
cues.en: Now inspect the actual records from September fourteenth, twenty fifteen, filtered as in the paper. Similar waveforms retain different noise. For comparison, the official plot moves Hanford’s record seven milliseconds earlier and reverses its polarity for the detectors’ relative orientation. Compare early and late cycles: the later spacing is shorter. A compact binary loses orbital energy, moves closer and orbits faster, increasing the inspiral-wave frequency. This separate orbit model explains the trend; it does not refit the event. Back in the records, Livingston received the signal first. The paper reports a delay of about six-point-nine milliseconds. Consistency also needs instrument checks and noise statistics; similar traces alone do not establish a discovery.

translations.实际 LIGO 还需腔增强与校准: Real LIGO adds cavities and calibration
translations.极微小的变化，怎样变成可信的读数？: How does a tiny change become a reliable measurement?
translations.机械响应、脉冲星计时与光学读出: Mechanical response, pulsar timing and optical readout

question.zh: 棒振了一下，为什么还不能宣布发现引力波？
question.en: Why does a vibrating bar not establish a gravitational-wave discovery?

lead.zh: 先看同样微弱的驱动怎样在共振附近增强，再比较共同信号与局部干扰。
lead.en: Follow a weak drive into a resonant response, then compare shared signals with local disturbances.

principle.zh: 共振增强机械响应；共现只能排除部分局部干扰，不能替代独立复核。
principle.en: Resonance increases mechanical response. Coincidences constrain some local disturbances but do not replace independent confirmation.

question.zh: 把驱动频率移离共振峰，响应会怎样？两台同时振动是否已经足够？
question.en: What happens off resonance, and are simultaneous vibrations in two detectors sufficient?

explanation.zh: 在相同微小应变的这个单模态例子中，响应减弱。两台共现仍可能有共同干扰或分析问题，必须独立复核；片中双通道是明确的合成对照。
explanation.en: For the same small strain in this single-mode example, the response weakens. Coincidences can still reflect shared disturbances or analysis problems and need independent checks. The two traces here are explicitly synthetic.

question.zh: 接收到的是射电脉冲，为什么能检验引力波？
question.en: How can radio pulses test gravitational-wave energy loss?

lead.zh: 把到达间隔连成轨道计时，再比较真实多年记录与两种轨道预期。
lead.en: Turn pulse intervals into orbital timing, then compare fixed multiyear observations with two orbital expectations.

principle.zh: 引力辐射带走能量，使轨道更紧、周期更短，近星点到达的提前逐年累积。这里接收的是射电，证据是间接的。
principle.en: Radiated energy makes the orbit more tightly bound and its period shorter, accumulating an earlier periastron time. Radio pulses supply indirect evidence.

question.zh: 图上累计提前约一分钟，是不是轨道周期已经缩短一分钟？
question.en: Does a minute of accumulated early arrival mean the orbital period shortened by a minute?

explanation.zh: 不是。每圈只略早一些，许多圈会累积成很大的到达时刻差。图的纵轴是相对原参考历表的累计近星点时移，不是轨道周期；读数、原点和原发表曲线保持固定。
explanation.en: No. Many slightly earlier orbits accumulate into a large arrival-time shift. The vertical axis is cumulative periastron-time displacement from the published reference ephemeris, not orbital period. Its points, baseline and published prediction remain fixed.

question.zh: 镜子动得极少，光怎样把它变成读数？
question.en: How can light turn an extremely small mirror motion into a reading?

lead.zh: 跟同一束光往返两臂，看光程差改变回程相位，再看合成后的光与真实两站记录。
lead.en: Follow a split beam out and back: path difference changes returning phase, recombination changes the light readout, and the two-site records provide the observation.

principle.zh: 两臂的差分变化改变回程相位；合适的工作点使微小相位差产生可读的光强变化。
principle.en: Differential arm motion changes returning phase; a suitable operating point turns a small phase change into a measurable optical-power change.

question.zh: 如果两臂一起等量伸长，理想差分读出也一定改变吗？
question.en: If both arms lengthen by the same amount, must the ideal differential readout change?

explanation.zh: 这个等臂、等响应的简化模型中，相位一起变化而相对相位不变，所以差分信号为零。真实LIGO还需光学腔、反馈和校准。
explanation.en: In this equal-arm, equal-response model, both phases change together and their difference stays fixed, so the differential signal is zero. Real LIGO also needs optical cavities, feedback and calibration.

question.zh: 为什么一小段越来越密的波形，会指向双黑洞并合？
question.en: Why can a short, tightening waveform point to merging black holes?

lead.zh: 先解释干涉仪怎样读出差分变化，再看两站固定记录中的啁啾与时间关系。
lead.en: First see how an interferometer reads differential motion, then inspect the chirp and timing relation in fixed records from both sites.

principle.zh: 致密双星失去轨道能量，间距减小、绕转变快，旋近阶段的引力波频率上升；两站一致性支持共同来源。
principle.en: As a compact binary loses orbital energy, its separation decreases and orbital motion speeds up, increasing the inspiral-wave frequency. Consistency between sites supports a shared origin.

question.zh: 如果只看见一个站的一次波动，能直接断定是双黑洞吗？
question.en: Can one fluctuation at one site by itself establish a binary-black-hole event?

explanation.zh: 不能。要结合另一站、仪器状态、噪声背景和波形分析。片中真实短段用于看懂信号与时延，不重算发现显著性或黑洞质量。
explanation.en: No. Other-site observations, instrument checks, noise backgrounds and waveform analysis are also needed. This real snippet explains the signal and delay; it does not reproduce discovery significance or black-hole mass inference.

title.zh: 极微小的变化，怎样变成可信的读数？
title.en: How does a tiny change become a reliable measurement?

description.zh: 从共振响应、脉冲星计时走到回程相位与光学读出，对照真实观测记录。
description.en: Follow resonance, pulsar timing and returning optical phase into measurable readouts and fixed observations.

chapterDirecting.object: One bar, its attached transducer and one displacement signal.

shots.action: Show the same weak input at 1600 Hz; bar-end motion and sensor response are small.
Compare the settled 1660 Hz response. The bar and attached sensing path respond together.
Detune again and let the response fall; retain the explicit enlargement/model label.

chapterDirecting.theoryAndPrediction: A resonant mechanical response is larger for the same drive near its natural frequency. Moving away from resonance reduces this example’s response.
chapterDirecting.phone: One bar/end-marker composition with a compact response trace. Avoid stacked controls or extra cards.

chapterDirecting.object: A and B traces with the same fixed background in each comparison.

shots.action: A local illustrative pulse appears only at A; B remains unchanged.
Reveal a deliberately shared damped component over the different fixed backgrounds.
Remove the common component; keep the historical lack of independent confirmation explicit.

chapterDirecting.theoryAndPrediction: A disturbance confined to A does not create the same B response. A coincidence still does not establish a discovery.
chapterDirecting.phone: Two compact rows on the same time axis. Synthetic identity remains visible; do not call either a Weber observation.

chapterDirecting.object: The same radio pulsar, the observer-facing velocity and the received interval.

shots.action: Identify the pulsar and fixed observer. Distinguish approximately 59 ms spin pulses from the 7.75 h orbital period.
Show approach/shorter interval and recession/longer interval. Orbit position, velocity, number and plot cursor share one phase.
Return to the same orbital state and timing pattern to motivate comparison of later orbital epochs.

chapterDirecting.theoryAndPrediction: Doppler modulation changes arrival intervals without requiring the intrinsic spin clock to alternately speed up and slow down.
chapterDirecting.phone: Compose the orbit/observer above a compact period-versus-orbital-phase trace, with the same-phase cursor and readable ms value. Preserve the bottom period plot referred to by the retained spoken cue; a local pulse-interval strip may supplement it only if the full player still fits. Do not replace the causal graph with a number.

chapterDirecting.spokenCue: Replace; new fixed evidence and energy bridge.
chapterDirecting.object: Fixed published periastron-time records, the zero-decay reference and the separately published prediction.

shots.action: Show early fixed points on the original year/time-shift axes. Keep the later points hidden but immutable.
A separate idealized energy comparison makes the orbit more tightly bound, smaller and faster. No exaggerated real-time historical shrinking.
Show the published GR curve and zero-decay alternative through later years. Hold a prediction moment before revealing observations.
Reveal the unchanged later measurements, retaining sparse epochs and the final 2012.8 point.
Distinguish accumulated early arrival from period change and identify this as indirect radio evidence.

chapterDirecting.theoryAndPrediction: If each later orbit is slightly shorter, periastron-time differences accumulate instead of staying on the zero-decay line.
chapterDirecting.phone: Use a single readable chart with three major ticks per axis and an HTML unit header. The energy comparison occupies a separate shot, not a second panel.

chapterDirecting.spokenCue: Replace; missing path → phase → readout mechanism.
chapterDirecting.object: The two returning beams and their sum at one photodetector.

shots.action: Trace laser → splitter → both end mirrors → splitter → detector continuously. Establish the labelled educational biased operating point.
At λ = 1064 nm, a teaching differential motion of 133 nm gives phase π/2. Show the two returning fields and their sum changing detector power together.
Hold a prediction for equal motion. Then move both mirrors +66.5 nm: relative phase and baseline-subtracted signal remain zero.
Reverse differential displacement; the baseline-subtracted signal reverses. Field, geometry and power share one model.
Explicitly switch to h = 10^-21: d = 4 am and phase = 4.72×10^-11 rad. Label the readout enlargement; actual numbers do not use enlarged geometry. Mention real cavities and calibration.

chapterDirecting.theoryAndPrediction: The readout senses the difference. Equal arm changes cancel ideally; opposite differential motion changes the sign of a biased small-signal residual.
chapterDirecting.phone: First a large L-shaped path, then a close view of the returning wave pair and their sum. Replace views over time instead of stacking a desktop diagram plus multiple plots.

chapterDirecting.spokenCue: Replace synthetic duplicate as evidence with real independent records.
chapterDirecting.object: The immutable H1 and L1 filtered strain samples.

shots.action: Reveal the independent records on the same UTC-relative axis. Their different noise remains visible.
Apply only the labelled official H1 comparison: left by 7 ms and polarity inversion. Keep both original sample identities.
Compare widely spaced earlier cycles and tightly spaced later ones in the actual recorded snippet.
A distinct teaching orbit explains energy loss → smaller separation → faster orbit → rising inspiral-wave frequency. Do not present it as a fresh event fit.
Return to the real records. Distinguish the 6.9 ms published estimate from the 7 ms display transform and state that instrument/background analysis is also necessary.

chapterDirecting.theoryAndPrediction: A one-site disturbance need not appear at the other station. Shape/timing consistency supports a shared source but is not a complete discovery test.
chapterDirecting.phone: Reveal each trace and then overlay them in one coordinate frame; keep 0.25–0.46 s and h/10^-21 axes readable. The source-orbit explanation gets its own temporal shot.

michelson.definitions: δLx and δLy are one-way perturbations of the two nominally equal arms. d = δLx − δLy is their one-way difference; the round-trip path difference is 2d.
equations: ΔP/Pin = sin(φbias + Δφ/2) sin(Δφ/2), an exact stable baseline-subtracted expression.
mandatoryBoundaries: At φbias = 0, power is sin²(Δφ/2): it loses the strain sign and is quadratic near zero. Show this as an exploration counterexample; never label it signed strain.

A quadrature bias is an explicit teaching choice that makes the small-signal residual signed and approximately linear. Use exact power for the larger 133 nm example. Actual Advanced LIGO instead uses a small offset near the dark fringe, cavities, a local oscillator and feedback.

The phase-demonstration displacement, optical detail enlargement and signal plotting gain must be labelled separately. None imply centimetre mirror motion or make raw optical brightness equal the published calibrated strain.
Keep tiny perturbations separate from the 4000 m nominal length; subtracting two rounded 4000 m floating values would erase attometres.

This is a quasistatic simple Michelson model with chosen normally incident plus polarization. It does not compute arm-cavity buildup, antenna response, control loops or frequency-dependent calibration.
Every drawn return path, wave phase, summed field, detector state and number must derive from the same optical state. Equal common displacement gives no ideal differential signal.

pulsar.explanatoryModel: Retain the existing older illustrative parameters for the Kepler/Doppler view. Keep this teaching model separate from the 2016 historical figure. E = −Gm1m2/(2a) and P² ∝ a³ explain why energy loss tightens the orbit and shortens its period.
pulsar.fixedEvidence: pulsar-figure3-fixed-data.json: 29 measured-marker positions and 144 independently extracted vertices of the published GR curve.
pulsar.independence: The GR decay prediction uses other timing quantities, which constrain masses within GR. The period derivative is then an additional test. Do not call the mass determination wholly theory-free.
boundaries: Controls cannot change historical observations, the published curve or their baseline. Preserve irregular observation epochs and the 1992–1998 gap; do not manufacture annual points.

The precise reference ephemeris of Fig. 3 is unspecified in its caption. It is not automatically Table 2 T0. Keep the printed baseline and do not silently apply another Galactic correction to the figure.
Hiding and revealing later points is classroom exposition, not a claim that the authors performed a temporal train/test split.

Quote the published 0.9983 ± 0.0016 ratio as published. Dividing rounded −2.398 and −2.40263 gives a slightly different last digit; do not retune the data or pretend to reproduce the precision from the graph.
The original figure’s roughly 62 s accumulated early arrival is not a 62 s change in orbital period. The period changes by about 76 microseconds per year.

No TEMPO re-fit was performed. The 29 figure points include years outside the locally available 1981–2012 main TOA analysis interval. The ambiguous gamma table-unit label is not imported into the model.

fixedLigo.inputAmplitudeUnit: 10^-21 strain; multiply by 1e-21 only when converting to dimensionless h.
fixedLigo.filtering: Official figure records already use a 35–350 Hz bandpass and instrumental-line rejection. They are filtered observed strain, not raw photodiode output, unfiltered data or a synthetic chirp.
fixedLigo.comparisonTransform: Official plotted H1 comparison is −H1(t + 0.007): H1 moves left 7 ms and changes polarity. This rounded display convention is distinct from the published arrival estimate of 6.9 (+0.5/−0.4) ms, with L1 arriving first.
boundaries: Preserve both stations’ independent noise and all fixed samples. Never clone one station, rescale amplitudes to force agreement or generate either observation from inspiral().
The H1 polarity inversion accounts for relative detector orientation for this event; it is not a universal rule that all stations have opposite signs.
No new significance, SNR, false-alarm estimate or black-hole parameter inference from this 0.21 s snippet.
A separate labelled leading-order inspiral can explain energy loss and rising frequency. It is not a fit to these observations and does not calculate merger or ringdown.
Render all fixed samples or a documented display reduction that retains extrema; keep the original immutable arrays and provenance.

weber.retainedModel: One damped mode with L = 1.5 m, f0 = 1660 Hz, Q = 1000 and h = 10^-18.
weber.boundaries: These are teaching parameters, not recovered detector sensitivity. Compare settled responses at fixed frequencies. Bar motion is slowed and enlarged. Synthetic common/background components stay deterministic across playback and controls.
weber.checks: Zero drive, near-resonance increase, off-resonance comparison, local-only versus shared signal, and finite inputs.
